title: Mistral and Mozilla are bringing open, private and multilingual AI to your web browser
facebook:
What if AI could live right in your browser — without sending your data anywhere? 🛡️ Mozilla and Mistral are building exactly that: private, open-source AI that stays on your computer and speaks multiple languages. https://aiworldhq.com/article/open-ai-in-your-browser-what-mozilla-and-mistral-are-building-together
